parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to correct the location based on the map. Valid values:
0: No. Trajectory correction is not performed.
1: Yes. Trajectory correction is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否结合地图进行位置纠偏。可取值：
0：否，不进行轨迹纠偏。
1：是，进行轨迹纠偏
parameters.name: map_match

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. <props="china"><ph>You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

<props="china">For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html.</props>

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs.
A ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information of all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html
parameters.help_zh:
